item.text: The file has three specimens per material, each measured across the same strain range. I’m treating the recorded range as the elastic region and fitting one pooled stress–strain line per material, so each specimen contributes equally at each strain level.

item.text:
The pooled linear fits estimate these elastic moduli:

- Aluminum: **69.38 GPa** (R² = 0.99834)
- Steel: **199.06 GPa** (R² = 0.99844)
- Titanium: **116.56 GPa** (R² = 0.99788)

I saved the write-up and figure here:

- [Results write-up](</private/tmp/tmpafbw8d1b/pete/projects/elastic-modulus/results.md>)
- [Stress–strain figure](</private/tmp/tmpafbw8d1b/pete/projects/elastic-modulus/stress_strain_fits.svg>)
